source_name: SEDEMA - Inventario de Emisiones de la Ciudad de Mexico y su Zona Conurbada 2022 (pub. 2026)
notes: CDMX (16 alcaldias) only, NOT the ZMVM metro total. Exact value 23,465,427 t CO2e. Table 3 p.30 and Table 27 pp.134-135. Also stated in text p.29: 'se estimo que en la CDMX se emitieron 23.5 millones de toneladas de CO2 equivalente'. SCOPE 1 (territorial): imported/consumed electricity NOT included.

Reconstructed from Table 27 (pp.134-135). Sum of stationary fuel combustion: area 'Combustion' block 4,099,528.25 (habitacional 1,439,796.10 + industria no regulada 2,431,878.48 + comercial-institucional 222,081.31 + equipos agricolas 5,767.06 + HCNQ gas LP 5.30) + point sources 729,076 (industrial combustion/process, excl. elec gen) + in-city electricity generation 105,948.64 + emisiones domesticas 276,535.46 + asados al carbon 26,102.00. SEDEMA does NOT report an IPCC 'Energy' sector; this is an aggregation of source-type categories.

Fuentes moviles (on-road) 16,989,279.7 + Moviles no carreteros (off-road: aircraft 417,811.72, machinery 369,812.57, bus terminals, locomotives) 812,724.85. Table 27 pp.134-135. On-road alone = 16.989 Mt (72.4% of total). If off-road is instead placed under Energy, Transport = 16.989 Mt.

On-road 'Fuentes moviles' only. Subtotal 16,989,279.7 t. Table 3 p.30 / Table 27 p.135. Largest single category. Autos particulares 4,530,064.43 + SUV 2,180,141.46 + taxis 3,336,138.38 + motocicletas 3,467,818.53 + micro/midibuses 1,029,874.50 + autobuses 954,112.95 + others.

WEAK MAPPING. SEDEMA has NO dedicated IPPU/industrial-process bucket; industrial point sources are reported as combustion and folded into Energy above. The only clean non-combustion F-gas/product-use category is 'Mantenimiento de aires acondicionados habitacionales' (HFC) = 1,776.10 t CO2e. True IPPU is effectively not separated by SEDEMA. For SISEPUEDE calibration treat IPPU as ~0 or reallocate part of point-source industry here if process emissions are needed.

'Desechos urbanos' parent group 357,254.80 (aguas residuales no tratadas 243,191.03 + tratamiento de aguas residuales 65,749.80 + rellenos sanitarios 22,474.40 + residuos solidos no gestionados 16,156.00 + tratamiento biologico 5,890.70) + quema a cielo abierto 3,792.87. Table 27 p.134. Dominated by CH4 (waste = 66% of all city CH4). Small in CO2e terms because SEDEMA uses AR GWP and most waste is CH4.

Agricultura 6,779.32 (aplicacion de fertilizantes 6,643.44 + quemas agricolas 135.89) + Ganaderia 42,323.23 (fermentacion enterica 40,916.82 + manejo de estiercol 1,406.41) + Incendios forestales 17,502.56 + Quemas controladas 541.35. Table 27 pp.134-135. NOTE: vegetation/forest CO2 sinks (LULUCF removals) are EXCLUDED from this inventory (see notes: 'se excluyen ... vegetacion'), so no negative AFOLU term. Only fire/agriculture/livestock sources counted.

'Generacion, transmision y distribucion de energia electrica' = 105,948.64 t CO2e. This is IN-CITY generation only (a point source). CRITICAL: emissions from the ~all imported electricity CDMX consumes are NOT in this inventory (scope 1 / territorial). See memo for quotes.
